title: Three-day forecast
instructions: Üç günlük hava durumu. Günleri, sıcaklıkları ve bölgeleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Here's the weather forecast for the next three days.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Today will be sunny and warm in most places, with temperatures of around twenty-four degrees.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Tomorrow, clouds will come from the west, and there will be heavy rain in the afternoon, especially in the mountains.

script.speaker: s
script.text: On Friday, the rain will stop in the morning, but it will be much cooler, only about fifteen degrees, and windy near the coast.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The weekend looks sunny again, so it's a good time for outdoor plans.

questions.evidence: Today will be sunny and warm

questions.prompt: Where will the rain be heaviest tomorrow?
What will the temperature be on Friday?
questions.feedback: Cuma çok daha serin, yaklaşık on beş derece.

questions.evidence: On Friday, the rain will stop in the morning

questions.prompt: What does the forecaster say about the weekend?
questions.feedback: Hafta sonu yine güneşli; açık hava planları için iyi.
questions.evidence: so it's a good time for outdoor plans.
